work.title: Add deterministic improvement evaluation suites
work.description: Create skill evaluation scenarios proving that Spec identifies repeated Verify returns, does not invent failures, cites supporting evidence, does not apply changes, avoids duplicate Works, and marks insufficient samples as inconclusive.
acceptance: Suites run without model credentials or network access where possible
Deliberately broken expectations fail the suite
Improvement outputs are stable across repeated runs
At least one scenario contains misleading noise that Spec must ignore
The proposal/apply boundary is explicitly tested
